jobs.description: About Us Riskified is the AI platform powering the eCommerce revolution. We use cutting-edge technology, machine-learning algorithms, and behavioral analytics to identify legitimate customers and keep them moving toward checkout. Merchants use Riskified to increase revenue, prevent fraud, and eliminate customer friction. Riskified has reviewed hundreds of millions of transactions and approved billions of dollars of revenue for merchants across virtually all industries, including a number of Fortune 500 companies. About the Role Our Product Management Team plays a pivotal role in our company, driving product success by working collaboratively with Riskified’s engineering, data science, design, marketing, analytics and Application teams. Product Managers at Riskified are required to solve complex problems, using a varied and multi-disciplinary skillset. We continue to grow fast, so we are looking for people who can learn and adjust quickly as the company and our product suite expand. Being part of our team means working alongside smart and motivated colleagues who consistently work hard and execute. Our philosophy centers around end-to-end ownership, which means that every team member is empowered and accountable. We hold ourselves to high standards, have ambitious goals, and are not afraid of trying new things. As an Fraud AI Applications Product Manager at Riskified, you will lead a broad and complex product domain at the core of Riskified’s business - the analytical delivery of our ML-based Fraud management offering. You will work with senior stakeholders to define our vision and build the strategy to achieve it. You will design products and processes to execute that strategy, work to automate and optimize complex analytical processes and develop Riskified’s next generation analytical performance platform. You will work with data scientists in order to solve optimization problems. You will envision and define the approaches and tactics in which operations teams - fraud experts and analysts deliver best-in-class analytical performance for some of the world’s largest eCommerce companies. You will engage directly with users - internal and external - to identify challenges and opportunities to increase the solution value. You will achieve alignment on the right solutions and build innovative solutions to tackle complex optimization challenges of fraud at scale while handling a large scale AI-based system. What You'll Be Doing Build the next generation of Riskified analytical performance platform to automate and optimize the analytics processes in a way that creates control and visibility, and brings business results Collaborate with our analytics and operations teams to define their needs and brainstorm potential solutions Partner closely with Data Science teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions and drive the development of advanced ML-based fraud detection capabilities. jobs.title: Product Team Lead
jobs.description: About Us Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world’s biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified’s AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights. Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Booking.com, Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and many more . We thrive in a collaborative work setting, alongside great people, to build and enhance products that matter. Abundant opportunities to create and contribute provide us with a sense of purpose that extends beyond ourselves, leaving a lasting impact. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day. About the Role As the Product Team Lead for Riskified’s Dispute Resolve solution, you will own the Dispute Resolve domain end-to-end, driving Riskified’s mission to help merchants manage chargebacks effectively, improve win rates, and scale their dispute operations. Dispute Resolve enables merchants to handle disputes efficiently - from ingestion and analysis, through evidence generation and submission, to performance optimization - helping them improve win rates, reduce operational overhead, and make smarter decisions about which disputes to fight. In this role, you will take full ownership of shaping and driving the Dispute Resolve product - hands-on, from strategy through execution - defining, executing, and evolving end-to-end dispute flows across multiple merchant setups, and ensuring the product delivers clear value and measurable outcomes. You will expand system integrations, evolve our evidence capabilities, and lead the product analytics function for the domain: owning key metrics, making data-driven decisions, and setting the product benchmarks that Sales relies on to sell Dispute Resolve. You will work closely with Engineering and Data Science to deliver robust, scalable solutions, translating technical constraints into business priorities and vice versa. You will also partner closely with the Go-to-Market (GTM) organization and Account Management to support product adoption, enable new deals, and ensure Dispute Resolve contributes to revenue growth, retention, and expansion. As the domain leader, your decisions and benchmarks will directly shape customer satisfaction, commercial success, and the long-term evolution of the Dispute Resolve roadmap. What You'll Be Doing Own the Dispute Resolve domain end-to-end, leading the definition, execution, and evolution of dispute management flows across different merchant setups. Set product strategy and roadmap priorities for Dispute Resolve, working hands-on with Engineering, Product Design, Data Science, and BI to deliver against them. Own product analytics for the domain: define the metrics that matter, monitor performance, and make data-driven decisions on prioritization and roadmap direction. Set and maintain the product benchmarks used by Sales to represent Dispute Resolve’s performance and value in the different markets. Lead the expansion and optimization of integrations with PSPs, gateways, and additional systems to enable scalable dispute ingestion and submission. Drive the development and continuous improvement of evidence capabilities, improving quality, coverage, and win rates across reason codes and merchant verticals. Translate complex dispute workflows and data challenges into scalable, intuitive product solutions that balance usability, automation and performance. Partner closely with GTM and Account Management to support product adoption, onboarding, and ongoing usage, and to ensure Dispute Resolve supports growth and retention goals. Engage directly with merchants and prospects to understand real-world workflows, validate solutions, and identify opportunities for improvement. Own backlog prioritization and roadmap execution, focusing on high-impact initiatives that improve operational efficiency and dispute performance. Serve as the go-to subject-matter expert on dispute management, representment strategies and product capabilities - internally and with customers. Qualifications 5+ years of product management experience, including leading a product team and domain end-to-end, preferably in a technical, data-driven or platform domain within global SaaS companies. Experience in the chargeback and dispute management domain (e.g. payments, fraud prevention or card networks) - a strong advantage. Proven track record defining and delivering complex, end-to-end product flows involving integrations, data, and operational workflows, from strategy through hands-on execution. jobs.description: About Us Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world’s biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified’s AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights. Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Booking.com, Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and many more . We thrive in a collaborative work setting, alongside great people, to build and enhance products that matter. Abundant opportunities to create and contribute provide us with a sense of purpose that extends beyond ourselves, leaving a lasting impact. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day. About the Role The Data Science department powers Riskified’s core engine by building production-grade algorithmic solutions at immense scale. As a Staff Data Scientist on the Identity team, you will drive the innovation roadmap for our Identity Graph Engine. You will architect, research, and deploy state-of-the-art machine learning models - spanning graph neural networks, transformers, and deep tabular architectures - to solve complex entity resolution and fraud prevention challenges at scale. What You'll Be Doing Drive Identity Graph Innovation: Architect and advance the next generation of our Identity Graph Engine using state-of-the-art graph models, transformers, and machine learning techniques. Technical Leadership: Define the research roadmap for identity resolution, setting technical standards and guiding complex research projects from initial concept to high-throughput production systems. Large-Scale Modeling: Build scalable predictive and representation-learning models over massive tabular, sequence, and graph-structured datasets. Cross-Functional Architecture: Collaborate closely with Data Engineering, Core Software, and Product teams to seamlessly integrate complex ML pipelines into real-time production environments. Mentorship & SOTA Research: Benchmark and import cutting-edge academic research into practical business solutions while mentoring senior data scientists on modern modeling paradigms. Qualifications Education: M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. Experience: 6+ years of hands-on experience designing, training, and deploying complex machine learning models in large-scale production environments. Deep Learning & SOTA Models: Proven expertise with Transformers, Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), or Advanced Tabular Learning architectures. Big Data Ecosystem: Strong practical experience working with large-scale distributed data processing systems (e.g., Spark, Databricks) and graph databases/frameworks. Technical Influence: Proven track record of technical leadership, setting architectural direction, and translating complex business requirements into high-impact algorithmic solutions. Advantages Experience in fraud detection, risk management, or fintech. Experience in Identity Resolution, Entity Disambiguation, Link Analysis, or Complex Network Modeling. Life at Riskified We are a fast-growing and dynamic tech company with 750+ team members globally. We value collaboration and innovative thinking. We’re looking for bright, driven, and passionate people to grow with us. Our Tel-Aviv team is currently working in a hybrid of remote and in-office work.
